item.title: Classical Commitment over Quantum Channels with Limited Entanglement Assistance
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Remi A. Chou
arXiv:2608.28500v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study classical string commitment over quantum channels with limited preshared entanglement. For noninteractive protocols, we determine the commitment capacity of a class of channels with input dimension d that, at each use, sample a pair of classical random variables (F,Z), apply one of the d² Heisenberg--Weyl operators indexed by Z to the input, and deliver the transformed quantum system together with F to the receiver. If E is the available entanglement rate in bits per channel use, then the capacity is minH(Z|F),łog₂d+E. This class of channels encompasses quantum erasure and depolarizing channels, as well as families of Pauli channels. 👤 Xianlong Liu, Antonio M. García-García
arXiv:2608.27897v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent examples have confirmed the common belief that quantum chaos is always suppressed in the presence of an environment. Here we show that this is not always the case. We compute the Lyapunov exponent of a q-body Majorana Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model coupled to a Markovian bath. Interestingly, this also applies to q=2 where the SYK is integrable which indicates that many-body quantum chaos can be induced by the environment. item.description:

👤 Runshi Zhou, Xingye Yuan, Linghang Kong, Fang Zhang, Kai Zhang, Zhaohui Yang, Jianxin Chen
本文利用超导量子比特控制方案的进步，系统研究了如何通过利用扩展的物理两量子比特门集（CNOT和CXSWAP）来简化具有非局域稳定子的qLDPC码的综合征提取。研究人员通过穷举搜索发现了一组名为“Bunny码”的qLDPC码，它们可以在超导硬件的二维最近邻量子比特连接上实现，并达到与需要长程相互作用的直接CNOT实现相当的性能。在周期性边界条件下，最佳的Bunny码在代码率上比环面码高出约3倍，在电路级模拟中，某些Bunny码的逻辑错误率比同等环面码低一个数量级。

item.title: High-Dimensional Deterministic Secure Quantum Communication with Reed-Solomon Erasure Coding
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 L. F. A. de Sousa Moura, G. L. Zanin, P. H. Souto Ribeiro, C. Becker Westphall
arXiv:2608.27679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deterministic Secure Quantum Communication (DSQC) is a quantum cryptographic technique engineered to transfer a message through a quantum channel, requiring an auxiliary classical channel for eavesdropping verification and decoding, but without prior key distribution. This article presents a theoretical high-dimensional prepare and measure DSQC protocol using the Reed-Solomon erasure coding to ensure data resilience to noise. This protocol offers the following benefits: it eliminates the need for quantum memory or entanglement, it can be built with commercially available technology, and its higher capacity improves the overall transmission rate.

item.title: TeMFpy: a Python library for converting fermionic mean-field states into tensor networks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Simon H. Hille, Attila Szabó
arXiv:2510.05227v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We introduce TeMFpy, a Python library for converting fermionic mean-field states to finite or infinite matrix product state (MPS) form. TeMFpy includes new, efficient, and easy-to-understand algorithms for both Slater determinants and Pfaffian states. Together with Gutzwiller projection, these also allow the user to build variational wave functions for various strongly correlated electron systems, such as quantum spin liquids. We present all implemented algorithms in detail and describe how they can be accessed through TeMFpy, including full example workflows. TeMFpy is built on top of TeNPy and, therefore, integrates seamlessly with existing MPS-based algorithms.
